Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, late 30s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob lavender hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy hot-pink PVC, made of two small triangle cups meeting at a short closed zipper between her breasts and held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom only by two thick polished gold chains with large flat links that hang straight down on either side of her navel from the lower corners of the cups to the top corners of the bottom, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin PVC molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, the dip of her navel, her ribs, her hip bones and the roundness of her bust and hips, the heavy gold chain links lying against her skin and catching the light, a fine sheen sliding over each contour, slightly lighter where it stretches thinnest. Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip.

Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a busy Hong Kong street at dusk with neon shop signs, crowded old apartment towers and a red double-decker tram passing; she stands in the middle of the road on the asphalt, car headlights and taillights streaking as long glowing white and red light trails in smooth curves on both sides of her, a deep blue dusk sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the colorful neon signs and the glow of the light trails with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot as a long-exposure photograph taken from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height on a tripod, glowing white and red car light trails streaking in long smooth lines across the road around her while she stands perfectly sharp and still in the middle, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the lane markings, a roadside barrier and street lamps around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
